english: antisymmetric / asymmetric / irreflexive
pashto: ضد متناظره / نامتناظره / نفي انعکاسي

decision: Labels must not collapse three distinct logical conditions. Antisymmetry permits mutual relatedness only at equal points; asymmetry never permits it; irreflexivity excludes every self-pair. Mere failure of symmetry or reflexivity is expressed as a negated sentence, not as these technical labels.

english: connected relation
pashto: تړلې اړيکه

pashto: جزوي / هرځاے تعريف شوې / تعريف شوے / تعريف نۀ شوے / مسلسل

english: Axiom of Choice
pashto: د ټاکنې بديهي اصل
status: provisional label, no exact native attestation

english: enumerable / countable / uncountable
pashto: د شمېر وړ / د شمېر نۀ وړ
status: regional technical attestation; target negation adapted
decision: Includes finite sets and countably infinite sets, with empty set explicit. Enumeration does not by itself mean computable enumeration. Preserve enumerable token and follow each source alternative definition.

english: enumeration / list / to enumerate
pashto: شمېرنه / لړ / په لړ کښې راوړل
status: attested listing concept; exact enumeration noun provisional
decision: Use شمېرنه as the defined enumeration noun, لړ for list, and explicit listing verbs. Every set member must occur at a finite position; repetitions are allowed in the main definition. Alternative bijective definitions must be signposted.

english: size / equinumerous
pashto: اندازه / همشمېره
status: general equal-cardinality concept directly attested; chosen همشمېره adjective provisional
decision: Size compares membership cardinalities, not spatial extent. Equinumerosity is not equality of the sets or the earlier equivalence-relation label. Infinite sizes follow source bijection definitions. Later visual inspection of the Bukovský/Niazman cardinality theorem directly supports equality of finite and infinite set sizes through bijections and all three equivalence-relation laws; it does not attest the exact adjective همشمېره.

english: finite/infinite
pashto: متناهي / نامتناهي
status: regional mathematical senses attested; infinite surface differs
decision: New evidence explicitly distinguishes finite, infinite and countable sets. The witness uses لاتناهي variants; retain edition نامتناهي as a consistent Pakistani-target choice, without claiming its exact attestation.

english: if and only if
pashto: هله او يوازې هله ... چې
status: regional technical construction attested; edition phrasing adapted
decision: Newly inspected definition explains both necessity and sufficiency. Native construction uses يوازې او يوازې هغه وخت ... چې; retain edition هله construction with both directions explicit. Earlier exact-surface uncertainty remains, but conceptual attestation is now direct.

english: pairing function
pashto: جوړوونکې تابع
status: regional concept and closely related label attested
decision: Witness calls it جوړه کونکې تابع. In this context the function codes ordered pairs as single naturals; distinguish from a function returning a pair. Preserve source arity and exact bijection formula.

english: ceiling function
pashto: د پاسني صحيح عدد تابع
status: provisional explicit descriptive term
decision: OpenLogic defines ceiling by rounding upward to nearest integer. Native integer enumeration uses floor and a different indexing formula, so it does not attest this exact label and its formula must not replace the source.

english: array / row / column / diagonal / zig-zag
pashto: جدولي ترتيب / قطار / ستون / قطر / زيګزاګ
status: native diagram supports concepts; exact edition labels provisional
decision: Describe the fixed OpenLogic table order, with rows and columns counted from zero; native diagram orientations are comparators only. Distinguish finite positions from an imagined position after infinity.

english: encode / decode / code
pashto: کوډول / کوډ بېرته لوستل / کوډ
status: pairing concept attested; exact encode/decode surfaces provisional
decision: Use code for the natural number assigned to an ordered pair, encode for the injective assignment, and an explicit read-back phrase for inversion. Do not imply encryption or a character encoding.

english: cofinite
pashto: د متناهي متمم لرونکے
status: exact term not found; source definition controls descriptive rendering
decision: The checked native set-theory pages attest finite and countable sets but not a conventional cofinite label. The edition therefore states the defining property directly: the complement in Nat is finite.

english: odd / even number
pashto: طاق / جفت عدد
status: regional technical attestation; Pakistani inflection adapted
decision: Use طاق for an odd natural and جفت for an even natural. In the pairing construction every positive integer has a unique power-of-two factor times an odd number; preserve that arithmetic role.

english: base / exponent / power
pashto: قاعده / توان ښودونکے / طاقت
status: regional mathematical attestation; Pakistani spelling adapted
decision: Distinguish the exponent from the power expression and its base. In 2 to the n, n is the exponent, 2 is the base, and the expression is a power of 2.

english: diagonal method / diagonalization
pashto: قطري طريقه / قطرول
status: native diagonal-method phrase attested; compact verbal noun provisional
decision: Use قطري طريقه for Cantor’s construction from diagonal coordinates. قطرول is a concise edition verbal noun for diagonalization and remains open to review. Every constructed object must differ from row n at coordinate n; do not reduce the argument to merely drawing a diagonal.

english: reduction (transforming one enumeration problem into another)
pashto: راکمونه / ... ته راکمول
status: exact technical term not found; compositional rendering is provisional
decision: Reduction direction follows the construction, not surface word order: to reduce enumeration of B to enumeration of A, give a transformation from any enumeration of A to one of B, here a surjection A to B. The checked native pages support the surrounding contradiction, function, and countability prose but do not attest the chosen reduction label.

english: no larger than / strictly smaller (cardinal comparison)
pashto: تر ... لوے نۀ / تر ... کوچنے
status: general cardinal comparison directly attested; Pakistani surface adapted
decision: No-larger-than means that an injection goes from the first set into the second. Strictly smaller adds absence of a bijection. Preserve direction, and distinguish cardinal comparison from subset inclusion or finite numerical comparison.

english: natural/integer/rational/irrational/real numbers
pashto: طبيعي / صحيح / ناطق / غير ناطق / حقيقي عددونه
status: regional mathematical attestation; Pakistani spelling and inflection adapted
decision: Keep the exact OpenLogic domains, including zero in Nat and nonzero denominators. The native regional pages directly distinguish rational, irrational and real numbers; formulas control membership and the edition does not infer a Pakistani technical standard from Afghan usage.

english: upper bound / least upper bound (supremum) / completeness property
pashto: پاسنی حد / تر ټولو لږ پاسنی حد (سپريمم) / د بشپړتيا خاصيت
status: bound and supremum concepts regionally attested; exact Pakistani compound provisional
decision: Completeness here means that every nonempty real set with an upper bound has a least upper bound. Keep it distinct from logical completeness and from mere absence of missing listed elements. The checked native pages support bound/supremum concepts but not this full compound.

english: Dedekind cut / proper initial segment with no greatest element
pashto: د ډېډېکېنډ پرېکون / ناتشه خاصه پيلنۍ برخه چې تر ټولو لوے غړے نۀ لري
status: supporting bound/order concepts attested; exact cut label unattested and provisional
decision: A cut is a nonempty proper lower initial segment of the rationals with no greatest member. Use the descriptive پرېکون consistently and do not confuse this order-theoretic initial segment with the finite initial segments used as enumeration domains.

english: commutative ring / ordered ring / ordered field; associativity, commutativity, distributivity
pashto: تبادلي حلقه / مرتبه حلقه / مرتب ميدان؛ اتحادي، تبديلي او توزيعي خاصيتونه
status: operation-law labels regionally attested; ring and field compounds provisional
decision: Keep the eight commutative-ring laws, total-order compatibility, multiplicative inverse for nonzero elements, and real completeness logically distinct. The native witness directly supports associative, commutative and distributive properties but does not define these structures.

english: Cauchy sequence / limit / tends to zero / convergence
pashto: د کوشي لړۍ / حد / صفر ته ورنژدې کېږي / تقارب
status: sequence, limit and convergence concepts regionally attested; Pakistani surfaces adapted
decision: A Cauchy sequence here is a function from the naturals to the rationals whose sufficiently late values are arbitrarily close to one another. Distinguish this internal Cauchy condition from already having a real-valued limit, since the construction is intended to produce the reals. Use لړۍ for sequence and an explicit approach-to-zero phrase for the null difference.

english: recursive definition / mathematical induction
pashto: بازګشتي تعريف / رياضي استقرا
status: mathematical induction directly attested; recursive-definition label remains provisional
decision: Keep recursive definition distinct from proof by induction. Induction has a base case and a successor-preservation step; a recursive definition fixes new values from earlier ones and requires a separate existence-and-uniqueness justification.

english: Dedekind infinite / Dedekind algebra / successor function / closed under a function
pashto: د ډېډېکېنډ له مخې نامتناهي / د ډېډېکېنډ الجبر / تالي تابع / د تابعې له مخې بند
status: Dedekind finiteness and successor-minimality concepts attested; algebra compound provisional
decision: Dedekind infinite means that the set injects into a proper subset of itself. A Dedekind algebra adds a distinguished initial element, an injective successor missing that element, and the least-set closure condition. Do not infer ordinary cardinal infinitude without the surrounding Choice assumptions when the direction matters.

english: isomorphism / isomorphic
pashto: آيزومورفيزم / آيزومورف
status: regional technical label directly attested; structure-specific preservation is source-controlled
decision: An isomorphism is a bijection preserving the operations and distinguished elements of the structures at issue. The native witness is for ordered sets; the same label may be reused for Dedekind algebras only with their own signature understood.

english: proposition (truth-bearing statement)
pashto: بيان
status: regional technical attestation; Pakistani spelling adapted
decision: Use بيان for a truth-bearing propositional statement. Keep it distinct from a proposition theorem environment, which is rendered as a formally asserted result rather than treated as a formula token.

english: semantics / semantic consequence
pashto: معنٰی پوهنه / معنايي استلزام
status: Pakistani semantics label and regional logic concepts attested; compound adapted
decision: معنٰی پوهنه names semantics generally. In logic, معنايي استلزام means preservation of truth under every valuation satisfying the premises; do not confuse it with a derivability relation.

english: truth function
pashto: د رښتياوالي تابع
status: truth-value and truth-table concepts regionally attested; exact compound provisional
decision: A truth function maps truth-value inputs to a truth value. The native page directly supports the two values and truth-table method, while the transparent compound remains a Pakistani editorial choice.

english: propositional variable / logical connective / negation / conjunction / disjunction / conditional / biconditional / formation sequence
pashto: بياني متغير / منطقي نښلوونکے / نفي / عطف / فصل / شرطي / دوه اړخيز شرطي / د فارمول جوړښتي لړ
status: formation and connective concepts regionally attested; Pakistani surfaces adapted
decision: Use the connective labels consistently and preserve whether a connective is primitive or defined. A formation sequence may contain earlier formulas and even irrelevant entries; only its last entry is required to be the formula it forms.

english: truth value / truth table / valuation / evaluation / satisfaction / tautology / semantic entailment / satisfiable / unsatisfiable / contingent
pashto: د رښتياوالي قيمت / د رښتياوالي جدول / ارزښت ټاکنه / ارزونه / صدق / تاوتولوژي / معنايي استلزام / د صدق وړ / د صدق نۀ وړ / اتفاقي
status: core concepts regionally attested; Pakistani labels and distinctions editorially fixed
decision: A valuation assigns truth values to propositional variables; evaluation extends that assignment to all formulas. Satisfaction is truth under a valuation. Tautologies are true under every valuation, contingent formulas under some but not all, and semantic entailment preserves satisfaction from premises to conclusion. Satisfiability requires at least one common satisfying valuation.

english: uniform substitution / simultaneous substitution
pashto: يو شان ځايناستي / هممهاله ځايناستي
status: formula-construction context attested; exact substitution compounds provisional
decision: Uniform substitution replaces every occurrence of one propositional variable by the same formula. Simultaneous substitution applies a listed family at once; do not read it as successive replacement unless a later definition explicitly fixes such an order.

english: axiom / axiom schema
pashto: بديهي اصل / د بديهي اصل شېما
status: axiom and schema concepts regionally attested; Pakistani surface adapted
decision: An axiom is an adopted starting sentence; an axiom schema represents all its substitution instances. Keep individual axioms distinct from the schema that generates them and from premises supplied by a theory.

english: formula / derivation / propositional logic / first-order logic / completeness
pashto: فارمول / اشتقاق / بياني منطق / د لومړۍ درجې منطق / بشپړتيا
status: regional subject, formula and proof vocabulary; derivation/completeness wording provisional
decision: A formula is an object-language expression; a derivation is a finite syntactic witness governed by a particular proof system. Completeness relates semantic consequence to derivability and must remain distinct from real-number completeness.

english: derivation system / derivation / theorem / derivable / inference rule / proof
pashto: د اشتقاق نظام / اشتقاق / قضيه / د اشتقاق وړ / د استنتاج قاعده / ثبوت
status: proof and inference concepts regionally attested; derivation label is an editorial distinction
decision: Use اشتقاق for the finite formal object and ثبوت for the broader mathematical proof or act of proving. A theorem has a derivation without undischarged external premises; derivability from Gamma depends on the selected system and must not be conflated with semantic entailment.

english: soundness / completeness / consistency / inconsistency / validity
pashto: سموالے / بشپړتيا / سازګاري / ناسازګاري / اعتبار
status: validity, contradiction and consistency concepts regionally attested; full property set adapted
decision: Soundness sends derivability to semantic consequence; completeness sends semantic consequence to derivability. Consistency is syntactic and satisfiability semantic, even when soundness and completeness later make the corresponding conditions equivalent.

english: sequent / sequent calculus / natural deduction / assumption / discharge / tableau / signed formula / axiomatic derivation / modus ponens
pashto: سېکوېنټ / د سېکوېنټ حساب / طبيعي استنتاج / فرض / د فرض ختمول / تابلو / نښه لرونکے فارمول / بديهي اشتقاق / مودوس پوننس
status: axiomatic proof and modus ponens attested; specialized calculus labels provisional
decision: Keep the four proof formats distinct: sequents arrange two sentence sequences, natural deduction tracks discharged assumptions, tableaux branch on signed formulas, and axiomatic derivations are linear sequences justified by axioms, premises or inference rules.

english: antecedent / succedent / initial sequent / logical rule / structural rule / main operator
pashto: مقدم / تالي / لومړنے سېکوېنټ / منطقي قاعده / جوړښتي قاعده / اصلي عملګر
status: sequent concept regionally supported by proof prose; specialized component labels provisional
decision: The antecedent is the finite sequence on the left and the succedent the finite sequence on the right. An initial sequent begins a derivation. Logical rules act on a displayed main operator, while structural rules rearrange, duplicate, remove or add sequence members without introducing a connective.

english: universal quantifier / existential quantifier / closed term / free variable / bound variable
pashto: عمومي سور / وجودي سور / تړلې اصطلاح / ازاد متغير / تړلے متغير
status: predicate and open-formula context regionally attested; exact quantifier compounds provisional
decision: A closed term contains no variables. The universal and existential rule schemas retain the source distinction between free occurrences in A(x) and the bound variable introduced by the quantifier; Pashto prose must not weaken those occurrence conditions.

english: eigenvariable / eigenvariable condition / weakening / contraction / exchange / cut
pashto: ځانګړے متغير / د ځانګړي متغير شرط / کمزوري کول / انقباض / تبادله / پرېکون
status: inference-rule concepts supported; exact sequent-rule labels unattested and provisional
decision: Keep the historical eigenvariable name even where the rule uses a constant, and state its lower-sequent freshness condition exactly. Weakening adds a sentence, contraction merges duplicates, exchange swaps adjacent positions, and cut combines derivations across the same cut formula.

english: end-sequent / topmost sequent / bottommost sequent / premise / conclusion / backward proof search / rule instance
pashto: وروستنے سېکوېنټ / تر ټولو بره سېکوېنټ / تر ټولو لاندې سېکوېنټ / مقدمه / پايله / له پايلې څخه شاته د ثبوت لټون / د قاعدې کارونه
status: proof and conclusion language regionally supported; exact sequent-tree labels and backward-search compound provisional
decision: A finite derivation tree is oriented with initial sequents at the top and its end-sequent at the bottom. Backward proof search begins with that end-sequent and matches it exactly to a rule conclusion, then continues upward through the corresponding premises.

english: proof-theoretic / reflexivity / monotonicity / transitivity / compactness (finite witness) / finitely satisfiable / Compactness Theorem
pashto: ثبوت-تيوريکي / انعکاسيت / يکنواختي / انتقاليت / د متناهي شاهد خاصيت / په متناهي ډول د صدق وړ / د متناهي شاهد قضيه
status: proof, consistency, satisfiability and relational concepts regionally supported; exact proof-theoretic and compactness compounds provisional
decision: The proof-theoretic compactness property says a derivation or inconsistency already has a finite witness. The semantic Compactness Theorem says a set is satisfiable when every finite subset is satisfiable, equivalently that semantic entailment already has a finite premise set. The edition uses one finite-witness word family while keeping syntactic consistency distinct from semantic satisfiability.

english: sequent validity / sound derivation system / induction on derivation / lowest inference / semantic preservation
pashto: د سېکوېنټ اعتبار / سم اشتقاقي نظام / پر اشتقاق استقرا / تر ټولو لاندې استنتاج / د معنايي اعتبار ساتنه
status: semantic and proof roles regionally supported; exact multiword sequent-soundness compounds provisional
decision: Validity means that every interpretation satisfies the sequent. Soundness is proved by induction on derivation height or inference count, checking that each lowest rule preserves semantic validity from its premises to its conclusion.

english: natural deduction / assumption / discharge / introduction rule / elimination rule / premise / conclusion
pashto: فطري استنتاج / فرضيه / فرضيه ايستل / د داخلولو قاعده / د ايستلو قاعده / مقدمه / پايله
status: proof-system and premise/conclusion roles regionally supported; exact natural-deduction and discharge compounds provisional
decision: Natural deduction is presented as a tree system beginning from assumptions. Introduction and elimination rules add or remove the principal connective, and labeled discharge closes selected assumption occurrences while leaving other assumptions open.

english: tableau / signed formula / truth sign / branch / root / closed and open branch / cut / eigenvariable condition
pashto: تابلو / نښه لرونکے فارمول / د رښتياوالي نښه / څانګه / ريښه / تړلې او پرانيستې څانګه / پرېکون / د ځانګړي متغير شرط
status: proof, truth, semantic and predicate roles regionally supported; exact tableau, signed-formula and branch compounds provisional
decision: A tableau is a downward-growing tree of signed formulas. A branch closes only when it contains matching true and false signs for the same formula. Branching rules create alternatives; nonbranching rules extend one path. Cut splits on an arbitrary signed formula, and quantified witness rules retain the exact closed-term and eigenvariable restrictions.

english: complete consistent set / saturated set / Henkin expansion / Lindenbaum lemma / term model / Truth Lemma / factored term model
pashto: بشپړ سازګار سټ / مشبوع سټ / د هنکين غځونه / د لينډنباوم لمه / ترمي مدل / د صدق لمه / خارج قسمت شوے ترمي مدل
status: general semantic, equality, relation, consistency, induction and proof concepts attested; exact construction and lemma labels unattested and provisional
decision: A complete consistent set decides every sentence while remaining syntactically consistent. Saturation supplies quantified witnesses; Lindenbaum extension completes the set; the term model uses closed terms as its domain. The Truth Lemma equates satisfaction with membership. When identity is present, the factored term model identifies terms whose equality belongs to the complete set and interprets symbols on the resulting equivalence classes. The compact Pashto construction labels are edition choices; cited Afghan works are regional comparators.

english: axiomatizable / decidable
pashto: د بديهي اصولو له لارې څرګندېدونکې / د پرېکړې وړ
status: supporting axiom and proof concepts attested; exact metatheoretic labels unattested and provisional
decision: Axiomatizable concerns presentation by axioms, while decidable concerns an effective yes-or-no procedure. Preserve their distinction and the source's implication for complete axiomatizable theories; do not infer native conventional terminology from supporting passages.

english: Löwenheim–Skolem Theorem / Skolem's Paradox / at most denumerable model
pashto: د لوېنهايم--سکولم قضيه / د سکولم پاراډوکس / تر ډېره شمېرېدونکی مدل
status: countability concepts regionally attested; theorem names and exact compounds provisional
decision: The downward theorem gives a finite or denumerable model to a consistent theory in the chapter's countable-language setting. The paradox distinguishes an externally enumerable model from sets that the model internally classifies as nonenumerable. The names are transliterated edition choices.

english: first-order language / constant / variable / term / formula / sentence / quantifier / scope / atomic formula
pashto: د لومړۍ درجې ژبه / ثابت / متغير / ترم / فارمول / جمله / کميت ټاکونکے / ساحه / اټومي فارمول
status: predicate, variable and formula contexts regionally attested; the grouped Pakistani terminology remains provisional
decision: Constants name individual objects, variables receive assignment values, and terms denote objects. Predicates applied to terms form atomic formulas; connectives and quantifiers form further formulas. A sentence is exactly a formula with no free variable occurrence, and quantifier scope and binding must remain distinct from mere symbol occurrence.

english: structure / interpretation / domain / satisfaction / validity / semantic entailment / satisfiability
pashto: جوړښت / تفسير / د تعريف ساحه / صدق / اعتبار / معنايي استلزام / د صدق وړتيا
status: semantics, entailment, satisfaction, domain and interpretation roles supported; exact first-order compounds are editorial choices
decision: A structure has a nonempty domain and interprets each nonlogical symbol. Satisfaction is first defined relative to a structure and variable assignment. Validity quantifies over all structures, entailment preserves satisfaction from every jointly satisfied premise set, and satisfiability requires one structure satisfying the whole set simultaneously.

english: variable assignment / modified assignment / value of a term / assignment independence
pashto: د متغير ګومارنه / بدله ګومارنه / د ترم قيمت / له ګومارنې خپلواکي
status: mapping, value and satisfaction concepts supported; exact variable-assignment compounds are provisional
decision: A variable assignment maps every variable into the structure domain. Its x-modification changes only x. Satisfaction of a formula depends only on its free variables, so satisfaction of a sentence is independent of the assignment. Keep this semantic assignment distinct from object-language substitution.

english: inductive definition / structural induction / atomic base / generation clause / limiting clause
pashto: استقرايي تعريف / جوړښتي استقرا / اټومي بنسټ / جوړوونکے شرط / محدودوونکے شرط
status: induction and formula-generation concepts regionally supported; exact structural compounds are provisional
decision: The atomic clauses supply the base objects, formation clauses close the class under specified constructors, and the limiting clause excludes every other string. Structural induction proves a property by the matching base and constructor cases; it is not induction on a numerical index unless a separate coding is supplied.

english: model / theory / model theory / axiomatic method / characterize / preorder
pashto: مدل / تيوري / مدل تيوري / بديهي طريقه / ځانګړې کول / مخکښ‌مرتبه
status: theory, relation, order, entailment and countability concepts supported; model-theoretic compounds are provisional
decision: A model of Gamma is a structure satisfying every sentence in Gamma. A theory axiomatizes a class when its models are exactly that class. The preorder example requires reflexivity and transitivity together. Compactness and Löwenheim--Skolem limit which domain-size classes first-order theories can characterize.

english: many-sorted logic / second-order logic / higher-order logic
pashto: د ډېرو ډولونو منطق / د دويمې درجې منطق / د لوړې درجې منطق
status: supporting logic, predicate, relation and semantic concepts regionally attested; exact hierarchy labels unattested and provisional
decision: Sorts separate object domains. Second-order variables range over relations on the first-order domain, while higher-order systems iterate function or relation types. The edition uses one transparent order vocabulary and does not treat these three systems as interchangeable.

english: comprehension schema / predicative and impredicative / full and weak second-order semantics / categorical
pashto: د ادراک شېما / وړاندوينيز او ناوړاندوينيز / بشپړه او کمزورې د دويمې درجې معنٰی پوهنه / قطعي
status: supporting axiom, relation and semantics concepts regionally attested; exact second-order compounds unattested and provisional
decision: Comprehension supplies a relation corresponding to a formula. Predicative comprehension excludes second-order quantifiers from that defining formula; impredicative comprehension allows them. Full semantics quantifies over every relation of the relevant arity, while weak semantics supplies a selected relation domain. Categorical means unique up to isomorphism, not merely detailed.

english: type / function type / finite type / simple theory of types / lambda term
pashto: ټايپ / د تابعې ټايپ / متناهي ټايپ / د ټايپونو ساده تيوري / لامبډا ترم
status: supporting function, formula and induction concepts regionally attested; exact type-theoretic labels unattested and provisional
decision: A type classifies objects. The arrow type sigma to tau contains functions taking sigma inputs to tau outputs, product types contain pairs, and lambda abstraction binds a variable of the input type. The loanword ټايپ distinguishes this formal hierarchy from the chapter's ordinary ډول or sort.

english: intuitionistic logic / constructive / BHK interpretation / double-negation translation / Kripke structure and forcing
pashto: شهودي منطق / تعميري / د بي‌اېچ‌کې تفسير / دوه‌ګونې نفي ژباړه / د کرېپکي جوړښت او تحميل
status: supporting proof, proposition, semantics and induction concepts regionally attested; exact intuitionistic compounds and names unattested and provisional
decision: The edition uses شهودي for the restricted proof system and تعميري for its motivating requirement to provide witnesses or a chosen disjunct. BHK explains proofs as constructions; the double-negation translation embeds classical provability; Kripke forcing evaluates formulas monotonically over knowledge states. These roles remain distinct.

english: modal logic / necessity and possibility / accessibility relation / intensional and extensional / epistemic and temporal logic
pashto: مودالي منطق / لزوم او امکان / د لاسرسي اړيکه / مفهومي او مصداقي / معرفتي او زماني منطق
status: supporting proposition, relation and semantics concepts regionally attested; exact modal labels unattested and provisional
decision: Box expresses necessity and diamond possibility relative to accessible worlds. Accessibility conditions select modal systems. Intensional interpretation ranges beyond the actual world; epistemic and temporal readings reinterpret the operators without changing their formal scope. The edition keeps these readings explicit rather than treating مودالي as a generic qualifier.

english: reduct / expansion / substructure / theory of a structure / elementary equivalence / automorphism
pashto: راکمونه / غځونه / فرعي جوړښت / د جوړښت تيوري / ابتدايي هم‌ارز / اتومورفيزم
status: structure, theory, interpretation, relation and function concepts supported by regional sources; exact model-theoretic compounds and the automorphism label are provisional
decision: A reduct forgets symbols while retaining the shared interpretations, an expansion adds interpretations, a substructure closes the inherited operations on a smaller domain, and the theory of a structure collects its true sentences. Elementary equivalence concerns the same sentences; isomorphism is stronger, and an automorphism maps a structure onto itself. The edition keeps these roles distinct.

english: partial isomorphism / back-and-forth / quantifier rank / n-equivalence
pashto: جزوي آيزومورفيزم / مخ او شا / د کميت ټاکونکو رتبه / n-هم‌ارز
status: partial, relation, quantifier and induction concepts supported by regional sources; exact back-and-forth and quantifier-rank compounds are provisional
decision: A partial isomorphism is a finite injective map preserving the relevant constants, predicates and functions on its domain. Back-and-forth extends its domain and range alternately. Quantifier rank counts nested quantifiers, while n-equivalence compares sentences up to that rank. The edition does not collapse these notions into ordinary equivalence.

english: overspill / arbitrarily large finite models / infinite model
pashto: له بريده اوښتنه / د هرې کچې متناهي مدلونه / نامتناهي مدل
status: finite, infinite, model and compactness concepts supported by regional sources; exact overspill label is a provisional descriptive choice
decision: The overspill argument expands the language by pairwise-distinct constants. If every finite size bound is met, compactness yields a model satisfying all distinctness requirements, hence an infinite model. The descriptive Pashto title signals crossing every finite bound rather than a claim about nonstandard arithmetic.

english: dense linear order without endpoints / Cantor's theorem / rational order
pashto: بې له سرحدي ټکو ګڼ خطي ترتيب / د کانتور قضيه / د ناطقو عددونو ترتيب
status: order, countability, relation and isomorphism concepts supported by regional sources; exact dense-order and theorem-name surfaces are provisional
decision: The chosen title says that every two distinct ordered points have another point between them and that no endpoint exists. The word ګڼ is kept as a transparent Pakistani-target rendering of dense, while countability remains شمېرېدونکی elsewhere; the two are not conflated.

english: standard model / non-standard model / standard and non-standard element / standard numeral
pashto: معياري مدل / نامعياري مدل / معياري او نامعياري عنصر / معياري عددنښه
status: model, structure, domain, function, relation and countability concepts supported by regional sources; exact arithmetic-model compounds are provisional
decision: A standard arithmetic model is isomorphic to the natural-number structure. A nonstandard model has elements outside the values of every standard numeral. The edition keeps model, structure, domain element and numeral distinct and uses معياري and نامعياري consistently.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete models-of-arithmetic source and language review

english: Robinson arithmetic / Peano arithmetic / true arithmetic / model of arithmetic
pashto: د رابنسن حساب / د پيانو حساب / رښتينی حساب / د حساب مدل
status: arithmetic, theory, proof and induction concepts supported by regional sources; eponym spellings and the exact true-arithmetic compound are provisional
decision: Robinson arithmetic supplies the weak finite axioms Q, Peano arithmetic adds induction, and true arithmetic is the complete theory of the standard natural-number structure. These labels remain separate throughout the model constructions.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete models-of-arithmetic source and language review

english: successor / predecessor / block / dense ordering of non-standard blocks
pashto: جانشين / مخکښېنی / بلاک / د نامعياري بلاکونو ګڼ ترتيب
status: function, order, countability and induction roles supported by regional sources; exact nonstandard block vocabulary is provisional
decision: A block contains the finitely many successor and predecessor iterates around one nonstandard element. Distinct blocks are ordered by the interpreted less-than relation and, in an enumerable model, form a denumerable dense order without endpoints. Zero is excluded from the predecessor claim.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete models-of-arithmetic source and language review

english: computable model / computable function / decidable relation / Tennenbaum's theorem
pashto: محاسبه کېدونکی مدل / محاسبه کېدونکې تابع / پرېکړه کېدونکې اړيکه / د ټېننباوم قضيه
status: function, relation, domain and countability concepts supported by regional sources; exact computability compounds and theorem name are provisional
decision: A computable arithmetic structure has domain Nat, computable successor, addition and multiplication, and a decidable order relation. Tennenbaum's theorem excludes computable nonstandard models; standard computable copies remain unique only up to isomorphism.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete models-of-arithmetic source and language review

english: interpolation theorem / interpolant / separates / inseparable
pashto: د منځګړيتوب قضيه / منځګړی / بېلوي / نه بېلېدونکی
status: entailment, sentence and proof concepts supported by regional sources; exact interpolation and separation labels are provisional
decision: An interpolant C lies semantically between A and B and uses only their shared nonlogical vocabulary. Separation is the equivalent two-set formulation; inseparability means that no sentence in the common language separates the sets.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete interpolation source and language review

english: definability / explicit definition / implicit definition / Beth definability theorem
pashto: تعريف‌وړتيا / څرګند تعريف / ضمني تعريف / د بېت د تعريف‌وړتيا قضيه
status: definition, predicate, relation and semantic concepts supported by regional sources; exact compounds and theorem name are provisional
decision: An explicit definition gives an L-formula equivalent to P. An implicit definition requires any two P-expansions of the same L-structure satisfying the theory to assign the same relation to P. Beth's theorem identifies these two conditions.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete interpolation source and language review

english: joint consistency / maximally inseparable pair / maximal consistent set / Robinson's joint consistency theorem
pashto: ګډه سازګاري / اعظمي نه بېلېدونکې جوړه / اعظمي سازګار سټ / د رابنسن د ګډې سازګارۍ قضيه
status: consistency, proof, semantic and countability concepts supported by regional sources; exact joint-consistency and maximal-inseparability compounds are provisional
decision: The interpolation construction extends two inseparable sentence sets stage by stage, preserves witnesses, proves maximal consistency in the extended languages and combines their term-like models over the common language.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete interpolation source and language review

english: abstract logic / normal logic / elementary equivalence in L
pashto: انتزاعي منطق / نورمال منطق / په L کښې ابتدايي هم‌ارزي
status: logic, sentence, semantic and proof concepts supported by regional sources; exact abstract-logic and normality labels are provisional
decision: An abstract logic assigns a sentence set and satisfaction relation to every language. A normal logic obeys the stated invariance and closure properties. L-elementary equivalence compares truth of all sentences supplied by that abstract logic, not only ordinary first-order sentences.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete Lindstrom source and language review

english: expressive / monotonicity / expansion / renaming / Boolean / quantifier / relativization properties
pashto: څرګندوونکی / زياتېدنه / غځونه / نوم‌اړونه / بولي / د کميت ټاکونکي / نسبي کول
status: semantic, predicate, relation and function roles supported by regional sources; exact property labels and expressive comparison are provisional
decision: Expressive comparison is by equality of model classes. The normality properties separately control language extension, finite vocabulary dependence, isomorphism and renaming invariance, Boolean operations, existential projection and restriction to a definable subdomain.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete Lindstrom source and language review

english: Lindstrom's theorem / Compactness Property / Downward Lowenheim--Skolem Property / nonstandard stage
pashto: د ليندستروم قضيه / د متناهي شاهد خاصيت / د لوېنهايم--سکولم ښکته خاصيت / نامعياري پړاو
status: compactness, countability, order and model concepts supported by regional sources; theorem name and exact property compounds are provisional
decision: Among normal abstract logics, Compactness and Downward Lowenheim--Skolem force every abstract sentence to have a first-order equivalent. The proof turns failure at every finite back-and-forth rank into a nonstandard stage and then a partial isomorphism contradicting semantic disagreement.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete Lindstrom source and language review

english: computability / computable numerical function / model of computation
pashto: محاسبه کېدنه / محاسبه کېدونکې عددي تابع / د محاسبې مدل
status: zero, successor, projection, substitution and recursion concepts are directly supported by a regional source; the computability abstract noun and model compound remain provisional
decision: Computability names effective calculation independently of any one formalism. A computable numerical function maps tuples of naturals to naturals by an effective procedure, while a model of computation is a precise formal account of such procedures.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete computability-foundations source and language review

english: primitive recursion / primitive recursive function / base equation / recursive equation
pashto: بنسټيز بازګښت / بنسټيزه بازګشتي تابع / بنسټيزه معادله / بازګشتي معادله
status: recursion, zero, successor and induction pattern directly supported by regional sources; the exact primitive-recursion compound and equation labels remain provisional
decision: Primitive recursion fixes an initial value and each next value from the immediately preceding value plus parameters. Primitive recursive functions form the least class containing the basic functions and closed under composition and primitive recursion.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete computability-foundations source and language review

english: projection function / characteristic function / arity / zero function
pashto: پروجکشن تابع / ځانګړونکې تابع / ځاييزه کچه / صفر تابع
status: zero and projection functions and multi-place operations are directly supported by a regional source; projection loanword, characteristic-function compound and arity label remain provisional
decision: A projection returns one selected input and lets composition reorder, identify or ignore arguments. Arity counts input places. A characteristic function represents membership or a relation by numerical outputs, while the zero function constantly returns zero.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete computability-foundations source and language review

english: bounded minimization / bounded search / least witness
pashto: محدوده کمينه‌موندنه / محدوده پلټنه / تر ټولو وړوکے شاهد
status: function and induction concepts are directly supported by regional sources; the exact bounded-search compounds remain provisional
decision: Bounded minimization searches only below or through an explicit bound and returns the least witness, with the stated fallback when no witness exists. Keep it distinct from unbounded minimization, which may fail to terminate.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete primitive-recursive-constructions source and language review

english: prime / factor / factorial / sequence code / concatenate / element / length
pashto: اوليه عدد / عامل / فاکتوريل / د لړۍ کوډ / نښلول / غړے / اوږدوالی
status: sequence, pairing, power and function concepts are directly supported by regional sources; the grouped coding and concatenation labels remain provisional
decision: Prime-power coding represents a finite sequence by one natural number. Length counts indexed entries, element names the decoded entry, and concatenation preserves the complete order of both input sequences. A factor divides the coded number; factorial remains the conventional technical loanword.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete primitive-recursive-constructions source and language review

english: simultaneous recursion / course-of-values recursion / parameter-changing recursion
pashto: هممهاله بازګښت / د ارزښتونو د بهير بازګښت / د پاراميټرونو بدلېدونکی بازګښت
status: recursion and sequence concepts are directly supported by regional sources; the three exact variant labels remain provisional
decision: Simultaneous recursion defines several outputs together, course-of-values recursion may use the complete earlier value sequence, and parameter-changing recursion updates parameters during the recursion. Preserve each schema's arities and dependency direction.
decision_timing: contemporaneous owner terminology decision during the complete primitive-recursive-constructions source and language review

english: diagonalization / Ackermann-Peter function / non-primitive-recursive
pashto: قطرول / د اکرمن--پېټر تابع / نابنسټيزه بازګشتي
status: the diagonal construction is directly supported by a regional source; the proper-name compound and negated class label remain provisional
decision: Diagonalization forms a function that escapes an enumeration by differing from its nth member at input n. The Ackermann-Peter function is computable but grows beyond every unary primitive recursive function, so do not describe it as nonrecursive.

english: omega-consistent / consistent extension / refutable sentence / theory consistent with Q
pashto: اوميګا-سازګاره / سازګاره غځونه / ردېدونکې جمله / له Q سره سازګاره تيوري

decision: Omega-consistency rules out proving an existential sentence while refuting every numeral instance. Ordinary consistency only rules out proving a sentence together with its negation. An extension includes the earlier theory; being consistent with Q requires only consistency of their union and does not require inclusion.
